supportingSources.label: Silver Slugger machine and playfield overview

strategy.overview: Advance runners and build runs through the drop targets, W-A-L-K lanes, saucers, vari-target, and hit progression. Completing W-A-L-K lights the Mystery arrows; collect a lit Mystery saucer for a random award that can include two- or three-ball Multiball. There is no direct, guaranteed Multiball qualification route.
strategy.simpleOverview: Complete W-A-L-K to light Mystery, then shoot a lit Mystery saucer. Its award is random and can be two- or three-ball Multiball, so you cannot force Multiball directly. Keep advancing runners, repeat the right orbit to build and collect its Jackpot, and hit the vari-target for a Grand Slam during Multiball.
strategy.summary: Complete W-A-L-K, then shoot a lit Mystery saucer. Mystery can award two- or three-ball Multiball, but the result is random. Advance runners for runs, repeat the right orbit for its Jackpot, and use the vari-target for a Multiball Grand Slam.

quickInfo.name: Collect Mystery
quickInfo.summary: Shoot either saucer while its Mystery arrow is lit.

quickInfo.name: Start Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Receive the random two- or three-ball award from Mystery; it cannot be directly qualified.

quickInfo.name: Score in Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Drive the vari-target for a Grand Slam and keep advancing runners.

steps.text: Complete W-A-L-K to light the Mystery arrows at the saucers.
Shoot a lit Mystery saucer and follow the awarded feature; two- or three-ball Multiball is one possible result.
Advance runners with drop targets, saucers, W-A-L-K lanes, or the vari-target, then bring them home for runs.
During Multiball, drive the vari-target far enough to collect a Grand Slam.

alternatives.title: Play the repeatable right orbit
alternatives.when: Use this when Mystery is unlit or the saucer returns are dangerous.

steps.text: Repeat the right orbit to build its displayed Jackpot.
Return to the orbit when the Jackpot is lit to collect it, then resume runner progress.
Complete the Single, Double, Triple, and Home Run features to light Extra Ball.
Complete the target-bank sequence to build Home Run Bonus and light Kicksave.
If the run totals are tied after the scheduled innings, keep playing the added inning the machine serves.

machineSetup: Confirm whether extra ball and the Mystery awards are configured for tournament play.
Test the W-A-L-K lanes, both Mystery saucers, runner lamps, vari-target, drop banks, right orbit, and Kicksave.

cautions.issue: Multiball is a random Mystery award rather than a deterministic lock sequence.
cautions.response: Do not promise a start after a fixed number of shots; relight and collect Mystery until the machine awards it.
